title: lane r12 SE: disablement scoped surviving-only contradicts its own membership and example
description: Lane round 12. Lens: SE (validator: SA). Defect: the removal-shaped set includes not-collected members 'regardless of path surviving' but the only dormancy lane is surviving-only — and the lane's own canonical example (a feature-default flip) typically vanishes from collection via cfg, leaving it homeless: mechanism decides what intent should. Citations verified: contract:64, :173, :180. Proposed: resolved-candidate (the lane keys on intent alone: dormant-but-valid takes the disablement declaration whether the path survives or vanishes from collection; the join treats a declared-disabled vanished path as explained; cfg-vanished disablement fixture added).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the disablement keys on intent alone, covering surviving and vanished-from-collection paths; a declared-disabled vanished path joins as explained; cfg-vanished fixture added; the partition restated (gone-and-obsolete, relocated, dormant-but-valid).
